say:3:1320344001:1.text: Oh, Dura above... Kind sir, have you returned to help me out?
say:3:1320344001:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……艺术家先生，您是愿意帮我这个忙了吗？！

say:4:1320344002:1.text: I regret that I cannot complete the painting, but I'm able to offer my assistance in another regard.
say:4:1320344002:1.source_cn: 我不能补全这幅画，但可以用另一种方式帮你。

say:5:1320344003:1.text: While I'm unaware of the exact amount of your debts, I would be willing to acquire the painting at five times its value, a sum ample enough to procure a modest estate.
say:5:1320344003:1.source_cn: 我不知道你欠了多少债，但我会用五倍的价格买下这幅画。这...

say:6:1320344004:1.text: Five times its value??!! Ludovic must be loaded...
say:6:1320344004:1.source_cn: 五——五倍的价格！柳博米尔好有钱……

choice_prompt:7:1320344004.text: Five times its value??!! Ludovic must be loaded...
choice_prompt:7:1320344004.source_cn: 五——五倍的价格！柳博米尔好有钱……

say:8:1320344005:1.text: Five times... that's way too much! I can't accept that!
say:8:1320344005:1.source_cn: 五、五倍……这实在太多了！我不能收……！

say:9:1320344006:1.text: Look, even for Levski's sake, this painting isn't worth that much... I suppose I'll take three times its value, and that should be enough to help us pay off our debts and find a little peace.
say:9:1320344006:1.source_cn: 即使看在列夫斯基的份上，这幅画也不值这么多钱。我只拿三...

say:10:1320344007:1.text: Alright, three times it shall be.

say:11:1320344008:1.text: I can't thank you enough! You're truly a generous soul!
say:11:1320344008:1.source_cn: 谢谢……谢谢您！您真是一位好心人！

say:14:1320344009:1.text: This is great! Now, they won't have to deal with those annoying debt collectors anymore!
say:14:1320344009:1.source_cn: 太好了，他们一家总算不用为生存而担忧了。

say:15:1320344010:1.text: Ludovic, are you going to sprinkle a little preservation magic on this painting since you spent so much money buying it?
say:15:1320344010:1.source_cn: 柳博米尔，这幅画要怎么办？你花了那么多钱，要不要给它附...

say:16:1320344011:1.text: That will not be necessary. I intend to bring it back to Everstill Manor, where it shall gracefully decay until it is no more.
say:16:1320344011:1.source_cn: 不必了。我会把它带回永寂庄园，让它自然腐朽，直至完全消...

say:17:1320344012:1.text: After all... every entity in this world should have its own destined end.
say:17:1320344012:1.source_cn: 世上的一切……都应该有属于自己的时间尽头。

choice:7:0:1.text: The Valesa family surely is rich...
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 不愧是瓦勒沙家族的后裔……
